title: Super Admin - User Management - Understanding User, Roles, and Permissions
description:
Welcome to the video tutorial of Super Admin - User Management: Understanding User, Roles, and Permissions in this training video we will understand the followings:

- What is a User?
- What is Role?
- What are Permissions?
- What are the different types of permissions? (Screen Vs Extra permissions)
- Understand the basics of users, roles, and permissions.
